Contributor: petervelosy Discussion Comment No.: 1 Comment: Where did you take this English name of this mountain from? I am sure it is wrong, so I'll remove it unless we can assign a credible reference to it. Gulács and gulyás (which is indeed transliterated to "goulash" are not the same word in Hungarian (they have distinct etymologies). However, even if the etymology were correct, we should only assign native or foreign toponyms that are actually in use. Date: 2026-11-06T11:00:59+01:00
